anomalies.description: A large, sudden explosion occurs in the distance down the road, producing a massive fireball followed by a rapidly expanding plume of smoke and debris; the blast wave is visible as dust and vegetation are violently displaced outward.

Sustained violent unrest is indicated by the persistent large-scale debris/dust cloud, visible structural disruption, and chaotic environmental disturbance over multiple seconds; however, no identifiable crowd or group actors are visible to confirm collective action.
A large, sudden blast generates a massive plume of dark smoke and a powerful dust/debris wave that propagates outward across the street, consistent with an explosion.

Secondary effects of the explosion continue: the smoke plume expands laterally and begins to dissipate, while strong blast winds lift dust and vegetation, causing visible ground-level turbulence and displacement of shrubs and palm fronds; no new detonation is seen, but the aftermath remains dynamic.
